lines.text: Nicodemus, a Pharisee and a leader of the Jews, came to Jesus at night and called Him a teacher from God.
Jesus said no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again, and Nicodemus asked about his father's house.
Jesus said the wind blows where it wishes, and so it is with everyone born of the Spirit.
Jesus called Nicodemus Israel's teacher and said that just as Aaron lifted up the snake in the wilderness, the Son of Man must be lifted up.
God gave His one and only Son so that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
